title: The Mermaid Won't Save You Twice
description: She saved his life once and lost everything for him, only to be thrown away when he chose someone else. Now that he's in danger again, he begs for her help—but she isn't playing the hero this time. Watch to see what happens when a broken heart turns into sweet revenge.
